name: @wynding/mobile
description: Capacitor Host that packages the Wynding Host build (iOS / iPadOS / Android).

scripts.sync:ios: pnpm --filter @wynding/web run build:host && cap sync ios
scripts.sync:android: pnpm --filter @wynding/web run build:host && cap sync android
scripts.perf:android: pnpm run sync:perf && cd android && ./gradlew assemblePerf
scripts.release:android: pnpm run sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.release:android:bundle: pnpm run sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
